messages:
Sam Chen: FYI external pen test engagement landed from TrustAssure. Proposed window: 2026-05-12 to 2026-05-16. Need quick sync on scope, temporary RBAC, KMS access, audit logs export, and retest booking. Who can own each chunk? cc @Jen (sec) @Kai Lee @Luis (infra)

Jen (sec): I can lead intake + vuln triage. Immediate asks: 1) confirm list of assets in scope 2) define evidence windows 3) decide ephemeral access model for assessors

Kai Lee: I can do RBAC changes. Prefer ephemeral roles over blanket perms. Suggest: create `pentest/assessor` role with `sts:AssumeRole` and time-limited session. We'll also log AssumeRole events to CloudTrail.

Luis (infra): KMS question — assessors need to pull encrypted logs that live in S3. Do we give them Decrypt on customer-managed CMKs? Prefer to create a copy of logs re-encrypted to a dedicated pentest KMS key we control and grant access to that key.

Megan (ops): +1 to copy/re-encrypt approach, keeps prod KMS untouched. We'll need an S3 bucket with restricted lifecycle and an evidence retention policy (90d). I can provision bucket and bucket policy.

Jen (sec): Evidence window: retain 7 days pre-engagement and whole engagement window, plus 90d archive for retest artifacts. Also include application-level request traces for any endpoints targeted.

Sam Chen: For RBAC rollout schedule, can we sequence like: create role, deploy trapdoor CI job to remove perms after window, run smoke tests? Need concrete commands.

Kai Lee: Example IAM snippet we can use (will audit before apply):

```
# create ephemeral role (example)
aws iam create-role --role-name pentest_assessor_role --assume-role-policy-document file://assume-policy.json
aws iam attach-role-policy --role-name pentest_assessor_role --policy-arn arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/ReadOnlyAccess
# then create STS session with session duration 3600
aws sts assume-role --role-arn arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/pentest_assessor_role --role-session-name pen-test-session --duration-seconds 3600
```

Jen (sec): We'll also need to monitor for privilege escalation during tests. Add CloudWatch metric filter for "CreatePolicy" and "AttachRolePolicy" during the window and alert to #eng-oncall.

Luis (infra): KMS re-encryption plan (high level):
1) Copy s3://prod-app-logs/yyyy/mm/dd to s3://pentest-evidence/yyyy/mm/dd using s3 cp --sse aws:kms --sse-kms-key-id arn:aws:kms:..:key/pentest-key
2) Apply bucket policy that only allows `pentest_assessor_role` GetObject on evidence bucket
3) Audit: enable S3 access logging to evidence-access-log bucket

Megan (ops): I'll create the evidence bucket and lifecycle. Will add encryption using pentest KMS key and object lock disabled (so we can delete after retention).

redwood-bot: Reminder — create JIRA ticket for pen test intake. Use template: Security Intake -> PenTest.

Sam Chen: Action items (owners):
- Jen: create intake doc + vulnerability triage rubric and initial evidence checklist (due 2026-04-22)
- Kai: draft IAM role + assume policy + audit filters (due 2026-04-23)
- Luis: re-encryption runbook + S3 bucket config (due 2026-04-23)
- Megan: provision evidence bucket + lifecycle + policy (due 2026-04-24)
- Sam: book initial kickoff with TrustAssure and propose retest SLAs (due 2026-04-20)

Jen (sec): Retest window decision: retest will be scheduled for up to 5 business days after a fix is deployed in staging or prod depending on severity. For high severity (P1/P0) we want a same-week retest slot; coordinate with assessor.

Kai Lee: One more: For RBAC changes, request we do canary rollout via feature flag so we can revoke quickly if anything misbehaves. We'll add a guardian Lambda that removes the role at the end time if not already removed.

Luis (infra): Will we require any network access (VPN jumpbox) for assessors? If yes, we'll create an expiring jumpbox account with session recording. Prefer avoid direct VPC peering.

Megan (ops): Assessors asked for SSH to a bastion only for app-level tests — we'll stand up ephemeral bastion with auditd and session recordings to S3 encrypted with pentest KMS key.

Sam Chen: Good. I'll open the JIRA and link here. Also logging: ensure we export KMS key usage and CloudTrail event history for the engagement period. Jen, add that to intake checklist.

Jen (sec): Will do. Quick vuln triage notes: ask assessors to tag findings with `evidence_path` and `repro_steps` and include PoC code where possible. We'll track fixes in a `pen-test` JIRA sprint for visibility.

Sam Chen: Thanks all — next checkpoint Friday 2026-04-24 10:00 PT. If anything blocks owners, drop updates here. :thumbsup:
